title: Market Saturation Ratio
scenario: Calculate the percentage of customers who have bought at least 50% of the available products. Return 'saturation_percentage'.
tableSchema: customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT), product (product_key INT)
hint: Divide count of distinct products per customer by total products in Product table.
correctQuery: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dist_p >= 0.5 * total_p THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) AS saturation_percentage FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS dist_p FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id) t1, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_p FROM product) t2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); CREATE TABLE product (product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 1), (1, 2); INSERT INTO product VALUES (1), (2), (3);
